content:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout wave 3 -> 50% traffic on runtime v2.1.0 + runtime-kernel v5.4, router v3.2.1, api v1.9. Please follow pinning instructions if you own an endpoint. rollout_id=rl-20260318-03 :rocket:

sarah: quick question — does the console schema change in this release affect the webhook payload? I saw a field rename in the PR but wanted to confirm behavior during the warmup window.

kevin: yes console sends `session_id` -> `session_ref` in events. Console has a compatibility shim for 48h but it only translates for POST /events. If you rely on query params it won't be translated.

sandeep: important: runtime v2.1 enables continuous batching and changes accept header `x-rdf` for cache affinity. Router v3.2.1 understands it, but API v1.9 defaults to old header. We should pin api->router compatibility to router:v3.1 for the first 30m for low-latency routes.

olivia: are we doing that pin? I'd rather avoid a hard pin if we can do a router fallback policy instead. What's the rollback criteria?

kevin: fallback policy is fine — plan: router will accept both headers and prefer new kernel when latency < 120ms. If p50 or error rate for generate route increases > 3x baseline in 10m we flip to pinned variant (router:v3.1). Manual rollback if p50 > 500ms for 15m or 5% 5xxs.

sarah: noted. for console webhooks, DEV and STAGE already have shim enabled; PROD needs the shim deployed to console-canary cluster. ops @deploy-bot can you add console-canary shim?

deploy-bot: queued job console/shim-deploy -> canary. ci-job: 4512 started. ETA ~8m. Logs: https://ci.internal/4512 :robot_face:

tim: posting quick rollback commands so folks have them handy:
```
# scale router back to pinned
kubectl -n router set image deploy/router router=registry/redwood/router:v3.1 --record
# revert runtime to v2.0
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry/redwood/runtime:v2.0 --record
# pin api to old routing
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/flags -d '{"route_pin":"router:v3.1"}'
```

olivia: thanks. also please add a note in the release notes about the header change and the telemetry toggle we added. link?

sandeep: release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/rl-20260318-03.md — added telemetry toggle instructions and canary fallout steps.

qa-bot: smoke checks running: generate/p50=98ms, generate/error-rate=0.6%, embeddings/p50=42ms. smoke ok on canary so far.

kevin: can we run a targeted traffic split test for the top-5 latency-sensitive routes first? push 10% then 25 then 50 over 45m. If any route exceeds the p50 threshold we'll abort.

sarah: +1 to staged split. I'm on-call for the first 60m, ping me if anything weird.

olivia: I'll update the release notes and add the manual hold checklist (who to call, slack channel, rollback commands, telemetry dashboards).

deploy-bot: canary job console/shim-deploy succeeded in 6m. canary: console-canary-2 running.

tim: starting 10% split now for routes: /generate /chat /embed/text /rerank /meta-health. will monitor dashboards.

qa-bot: after 10% split: generate/p50=110ms (+12%), generate/error-rate=0.9% (+0.3pp). still under threshold. embeddings unchanged.

kevin: keep the staged plan. if we see error-rate spike to +1.5pp or p50 > 200ms we abort.

olivia: notify support and customer success: short note in #customer-status that we may see small latency blips for 30-60m.

sandeep: one more callout — legacy clients that rely on `session_id` must be accounted for. ops to run migration flag: `console.legacy_session_forwarder=true` in PROD for 24h.

kevin: ops already set it for canary; will propagate to prod at +60m if canary stable.

sarah: if anyone sees a persistent 5xx trend, call the rollback path immediately. we don't need extra approvals for emergency rollback during the window.

deploy-bot: rollout wave 3 -> 50% scheduled bump in 30m if no abort signal. monitoring hooks: https://dashboards.internal/rl-20260318-03. Alerts to #eng-oncall and #incidents.

tim: noted. I'll be watching and will post a short status update at +15m and +45m.

olivia: thanks all. tagging owners in the release notes: @sarah @kevin @sandeep.

sarah: +1. ready to flip back if needed. :white_check_mark:
